1. (Currently Amended) A system for generating a counter-stimulation in a patient suffering from RLS, the system comprising: a device configured and arranged to generate a counter-stimulation in a patient suffering from RLS via __vibration__, the counter-stimulation of an amplitude, intensity, and time duration either lower than that which would wake the patient and higher than that sufficient to relieve RLS symptoms, or sufficient to relieve RLS symptoms and allow the patient to return to sleep; a controller configured and arranged to drive the counter-stimulation generation device, the controller in communication with the counter-stimulation device; and a base configured and arranged to hold the counter-stimulation generation device adjacent to a patient, the counter-stimulation device __directly__ attached to the base.

2. (Currently Amended) The system according to Claim 1, wherein the device comprises __a vibration generator selected from the group consisting of a piezo-chip, a loudspeaker, a motor with an eccentric weight, and a solenoid__.

3. (Currently Amended) The system according to Claim 2, wherein the device comprises a vibration generator __comprising an electric motor having a shaft, and a weight having a hole therein, the weight positioned on the shaft, the hole located at a position offset from a center of mass of the weight__.
